newsitem.title: USA: Childtime Learning opens four centers.
newsitem.headline: Childtime Learning opens four centers.

text.p: Childtime Learning Centers Inc said Tuesday it opened four facilities, including one "at-work" center, one acquisition and two newly built facilities.

"These additions fit our growth strategy to expand our business by 25 to 30 centers a year," said chief executive officer Harold Lewis. "Since the beginning of the fiscal year, we've added 20 centers."
The child care and preschool services company now has 194 centers nationally.
